versions.changelog:
Initial release of "carpet-wash-video" for auto-generating vertical, satisfying carpet cleaning shorts.

- Generates text-to-video or image-to-video (dirty carpet photos to rinse and reveal)
- Designed for strong before/after, ASMR, grime runoff, and fiber revival effects
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js 18+
- Prompts are expanded for rich, shot-accurate, and niche-specific video descriptions
- Includes workflow, CLI usage, parameter defaults, and robust prompt confirmation steps
